verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ISO 27001 is one of several frameworks Sprinto manages with pre-mapped controls and audit workflows, but there is no evidence of Annex A control set specifics, Statement of Applicability generation, or ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts — only generic multi-framework mapping language is shown. missing for 10: explicit Annex A control catalogue, SoA generation/management, ISO 27001 certification-audit artifact templates, and any independent corroboration of ISO-specific depth.
